common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D dark fantasy RPG inventory icon sprite atlas, transparent PNG. Create exactly TWELVE distinct square equipment icons in an exact FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW grid. All cells have identical square size, straight aligned rows, substantial transparent gutters between cells and around the canvas. Each cell is an individual engraved ancient-gold Gothic metal frame around a very dark blue-black inset. The background OUTSIDE the twelve individual frames must be genuine transparent alpha, not black, not gray, no checkerboard. Hand-painted richly textured illustration, elegant restraint, crisp bold silhouette readable at 64 pixels. Complete equipment with all extremities safely inside its own frame. Use 1536 by 1152 composition if possible. No text, no letters, no labels, no humans, no heads, no hands wearing the equipment, no UI menus. Columns in EVERY row are 1) a single warrior gauntlet showing separate finger knuckles, 2) a broad hard warrior breastplate/shoulder armor, 3) a mage's long staff shown diagonally with complete shaft and distinctive head, 4) an empty cloth mage robe with long sleeves and complete hem. Warrior armor must look structurally hard and wide; mage robes must have visible folds, hanging cloth, long sleeves and distinct tailoring, NEVER look like another breastplate. The three rows MUST have radically different silhouette, material and internal palette, not the same object with another gem. Use fewer large readable motifs instead of repeating tiny filigree. Keep the ornate frame thin so each item silhouette occupies about 75 percent of the square.
q0: Rarity: COMMON WHITE. Frames are aged dark gold with SMALL SILVER-WHITE rarity jewels. Each row has a unique humble material identity and is less luxurious than epic gear. Row A TRAVEL LANTERN: brown leather fingerless finger-knuckle gauntlet with a round brass lamp medallion and compact wrist; broad rugged leather warrior cuirass with iron rivets and asymmetric single pauldron; simple crooked wooden walking staff with a caged hanging amber lantern at its top, not a crystal staff; short-sleeved layered dark beige traveling mage robe with scarf and offset waist sash. Row B COLD IRON: long narrow riveted iron gauntlet with visible chainmail cuff, squared icy steel knuckles and hanging chain; rectangular cold gray iron chest armor with chainmail shoulders and high collar; tall straight iron staff ending in TWO angular opposing ice prongs around a small white ice shard; long closed high-collared gray-blue wool mage coat with angular wide cuffs and silver chain fastening, no armored shoulders. Row C DUSK COPPER: extremely broad rounded copper gauntlet with large circular shield-like disk over back of fist and short wide wrist, no ice spikes; rounded barrel-like bronze warrior cuirass with TWO circular broad shoulder disks and green-patinated copper; twisted copper staff whose head is a huge open copper circular ring with a small hanging verdigris bell; hooded heavy verdigris-and-copper cloth robe with a wide bell hem, copper ring belt and long drooping sleeves. These three rows must be unmistakably leather / cold iron chains / warm copper circles even in grayscale.
q2: Rarity: RARE BLUE. Frames are aged dark gold with SMALL BLUE rarity jewels. Row A FROST CRYSTAL: angular pale cyan translucent gauntlet with three long ice-blade fins sweeping backward from a slim wrist; wide sharp triangular frost-crystal warrior breastplate with asymmetrical jagged icy pauldrons; straight white staff with a large elongated diamond-shaped ice spearhead and a narrow crystal shaft; fitted white-blue cloth mage robe with sharply split long tails and ice-collar, cloth sleeves rather than armor. Row B TIDAL PATTERN: squat rounded teal shell gauntlet with spiral conch knuckles and wide scallop-shell cuff; broad rounded deep teal breastplate with curved scallop shoulder shells and pearly segmented belly; curving coral branch staff crowned by a giant spiral sea shell and a suspended pearl; open flowing dark teal ocean mage coat with sweeping fin-like long sleeves and wavy layered hem, a broad sash. Row C THUNDER INSCRIPTION: black-steel gauntlet with zigzag yellow-blue lightning claws at knuckles and long forked elbow guard; angular dark indigo iron warrior armor with forked lightning-shaped shoulder wings and segmented narrow waist; very crooked zigzag metal staff with a huge offset fork-shaped thunderblade head and blue electric core; short-front long-back dark indigo cloth mage robe with enormous angular cuff shapes and split lightning-shaped hem, thin silver runes. Give the frost / shell / thunder rows dramatically different shapes, not merely different colors.
q3: Rarity: EPIC PURPLE. Frames are aged dark gold with SMALL PURPLE rarity jewels. Row A WITHERED MOON: curved ivory-bone gauntlet with hooked crescent guard and visible pale bony finger knuckles over black leather; broad pale bone warrior chest armor with two huge downward-curving crescent shoulder horns and a dark cavity center; crooked pale bone staff crowned by a huge ivory crescent moon open to the right and a SMALL violet orb hanging inside; ivory and charcoal mage robe with a deep draped round cowl, broad sleeves, frayed asymmetric hem and crescent embroidery, mostly pale fabric. Row B MIRROR ABYSS: chunky black obsidian and icy reflective silver gauntlet with a broad rectangular mirrored plate over knuckles and an open triangular split wrist guard; wide black obsidian warrior cuirass with faceted mirror-panel shoulders and a bright cool silver center, rectangular architecture; long bifurcated metallic staff crowned by TWO floating tall mirror shards forming an open fork around a dark blue-purple void, no crescent; tall narrow dark navy mage coat with severe V-shaped collar, two long straight front panels, reflective silver shard cuffs and small violet seams, no hood. Row C STAR THORN: organic dark gnarled-wood gauntlet with long thorn ridges and a prominent jagged magenta star seed embedded at wrist; bark-and-black-metal warrior breastplate with jagged thorn-branch shoulder spikes radiating from a star core, visibly woody; tangled thorn-vine staff crowned by an irregular five-pointed violet star in a spiky open thorn cage; deep plum cloth druid-mage mantle with a short pointed capelet, wide uneven leaf-shaped sleeve cuffs and multiple tapered thorn-like cloth tails, no heavy breastplate. Ivory crescent / hard mirror fork / thorn star must all be immediately distinct in monochrome.
q4: Rarity: LEGENDARY RED. Frames are aged dark gold with SMALL RUBY RED rarity jewels. Row A CINDER SUN: massive squat rough black basalt gauntlet with huge blunt magma knuckles, cracked orange glowing seams and a short heavy wrist; gigantic blocky volcanic rock and iron warrior breastplate with crag shoulders and orange molten fissures, compact torso; thick rough dark staff topped by a heavy irregular volcanic hammer-like sunstone emitting a few orange embers; sleeveless open crimson-black cloth mage surcoat with broad fiery ragged lapels, broad waist sash, one long flowing shoulder drape, no armored shoulders. Row B BROKEN TIME: long thin antique brass articulated gauntlet with an exposed clock gear wheel and open interrupted ring guard around wrist, pale sand energy; elegant tall hard warrior cuirass with two asymmetric giant broken half-gear shoulder disks and hourglass-shaped sternum; narrow brass staff whose head is a huge broken clock ring with visible missing segment and hanging pendulum, no fire orb; fitted sand-beige and black mage longcoat, asymmetric stiff collar, narrow sleeves ending in huge clock-hand cuffs, tapered coat-tails and broken ring brooch. Row C AZURE CONSTELLATION: star-forged deep blue metal gauntlet with long sharp stellar fins and silver-white star knuckles; broad navy silver warrior armor with tall slender star-blade pauldrons and bright white-blue constellation center; silver-blue staff with an ornate wide multi-axis astrolabe head, long spear-like stellar crystal through the rings; very long closed midnight-blue mage gown with immense bell sleeves, tall pointed collar, silver constellation tracing and a wide sweeping star-patterned cloth hem. Volcanic block / broken gear / thin astrolabe silhouettes must differ strongly; all rarity gems stay ruby-red even where item colors vary.
q5: Rarity: MYTHIC ORANGE. Frames are aged dark gold with SMALL AMBER ORANGE rarity jewels. Row A SOLAR CORONA: enormous radiant gold gauntlet with a semicircle of long sun-blade rays flaring from a broad fist, separate knuckles; extremely broad angular gold warrior breastplate with enormous outward radiating solar-blade shoulder crown, brilliant amber center; golden staff topped by a great solid central sun disk surrounded by long sharp radial blades, long complete shaft; dramatic open red-and-gold mage cloak with very wide flared split sleeves, a short radiant cape collar, long two-pronged trailing cloth train, clearly cloth not plate. Row B ETERNAL DAWN: slender long white jade gauntlet with curved gold feather-like plates sweeping back from wrist and delicate jade knuckles; rounded elegant white-jade warrior breastplate with two enormous upward-curving ivory feather shoulder wings, soft pale rose-gold seams; ivory jade staff topped by TWO huge curved golden wings embracing a narrow vertical white prism, not a circular sun; graceful closed ivory mage gown with a high feather collar, long soft bell sleeves, layered white cloud-like fabric and a broad gold sash, a round flowing hem. Row C ECLIPSE: compact wide black-gold gauntlet with a bold OPEN circular void ring behind its obsidian knuckles, no rays, restrained red ember edge; intimidating black-metal warrior armor with wide dark round eclipse disk pauldrons rimmed in gold and a hollow ring at sternum, blunt monolithic shape; curved black staff crowned by a massive OPEN BLACK ECLIPSE ring with a thin crescent gold edge and a tiny red light floating off-center, no filled sun disk; mysterious black hooded mage robe with broad heavy draping sleeves and a split gold-lined crescent hem, sparse circular void motifs, no white feathers. Radiating blades / sweeping white feathers / empty black rings must remain visibly distinct even at 64px. Avoid giant aura obscuring equipment.
